caption:
Paying off a floating-rate loan early? Is there a penalty?

Under RBI's prepayment-charge directions, loans to individuals sanctioned from 1 Jan 2026 on a floating rate can't carry a prepayment charge.
It applies to part or full prepayment, with no minimum lock-in, whatever the source of the money.
Fixed-rate loans can still carry a charge, so check your sanction letter.
